column8: Native Salesforce integration: This is, by far, one of Aircall's biggest strengths. The integration with Salesforce is seamless and powerful: calls are automatically logged in the corresponding contact or lead records, call recordings and notes are directly attached to Salesforce activities, and our sales team can initiate calls directly from Salesforce with a single click (Click-to-Dial). This has drastically reduced manual data entry and improved CRM data accuracy. VR, call routing, business hours, shared inboxes, call tagging, and analytics provide everything a growing team needs to manage calls professionally.
